biggest_catch: Election Day runs from ~6am until the Judge of Election dismisses you (after the 8pm close plus tabulation) for $150-$200 by role.
catches: Election-period work only; Election Day is ~14-16 hours (6am arrival until dismissed after the 8pm close).
Pay varies by appointed role: $150-$200/day (training session pays an extra $20).
Must be a registered voter of Dauphin County; poll board positions are appointed.
Training session attendance required (mandatory per county handbook).
Compensation set by Board of Elections Resolution #1-2022, effective 2023.

c1.evidence: Dauphin County PA Board of Elections meeting minutes (dauphincounty.gov, Elec-11-23-2022.pdf) and the Dauphin County election training handbook (dauphinelectiontraining.com, 2023).

c2.evidence: Resolution #1-2022 (effective 2023): Judge of Elections $200/day; Inspectors $175/day; Machine Operators/Clerks $150/day; training session $20.

c3.evidence: No fee to apply or serve.

eligibility: Registered voter of Dauphin County; poll-board positions appointed by the Judge of Election / Minority Inspector; training session required.
notes: Rate schedule adopted by Board of Elections Resolution #1-2022 (effective 2023), confirmed in the county's 2023 pollworker handbook.
numeric_basis: payout: official resolution rates $150-$200/day by role + $20 training session; time: official arrival 6:00-6:30am, 7am-8pm polls, stay until dismissed (est to ~9:30-10pm, 930-960 min) + training session (est 120-180 min)
payout_quote: Starting in 2023, the per diem rates will increase as follows: Judge of Elections from $170.00 to $200.00; Inspectors from $150.00 to $175.00 and Machine Operators/Clerks from $130.00 to $150.00. (County handbook: 'Paid $150 for the day, plus $20 for attending training session.')
payout_value_note: Official per-diem rates by role (Resolution #1-2022, effective 2023).

steps: Contact the Dauphin County Board of Elections (or be appointed through the Judge of Election / Minority Inspector for clerk roles).
Attend the required training session before the election (pays an extra $20).
Serve Election Day: arrive at the polls ~6:00-6:30am, work until the Judge dismisses you after the 8pm close.
timing: Election Day per the county election calendar; training session before the election.
